reviewSamples.author: Penelope De
reviewSamples.text: I have used Charcuterie Bree on many occasions and have never been disappointed!

reviewSamples.author: Sara Ferrer
reviewSamples.text: Bree and her charcuterie boards are the absolute best! She decorates all her boards beautifully and uses great quality cheeses and meats for a great price. She is creative and has plenty of options to choose from savory or sweet! 10/10 !!

reviewSamples.author: Michelle Rose
reviewSamples.text: I've purchased boards from Charcuterie Bree on several occasions, and she never disappoints! Boards are alway a visual delight and delicious! Bree is so accommodating and friendly, and can create something special for any occasion. I'd give her ten stars if I could.

reviewSamples.author: Brian McSwiney
reviewSamples.text: Bree has a great eye for making a beautiful looking board for any occasion from Holidays to special events. She can also custom make any order to fit your needs. We have had the greatest success and compliments whenever we use her.

reviewSamples.author: Gio+Carolina Romeo
reviewSamples.text: The boards from Bree are generously filled with fresh and delicious bites. I love the presentation, always in a brand new wooden board and she delivers, which makes it very convenient. Great addition to our events.
